WITH emp00 AS (SELECT * FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, to_date(replace(#{transDate},'-',''),'yyyymmdd'))) , org00 AS (SELECT * FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, #{transDate}::date)) SELECT FROM emp00 trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp00_org_code_id = org00_org_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp00_trans_cd = ( CASE #{transCode} WHEN '100' THEN (
CASE WHEN emp00_trans_cd <= '799' /** 겸직(800),퇴직(900)은 제외 */
CASE WHEN emp00_trans_cd <= '899' /** 퇴직(900)만 제외 (겸직자 재직자로 인식) */
THEN emp00_trans_cd ELSE #{transCode} END ) WHEN '900' THEN '900' WHEN '800' THEN '800' ELSE emp00_trans_cd END ) AND (emp01_kor_nm||org00_kor_nm||emp01_emp_no) LIKE #{searchText} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) )
AND emp00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId}
ORDER BY emp00_trans_date DESC, org00_org_cd, emp00_title_cd, emp00_pos_cd, emp01_order_seq
ORDER BY org00_org_cd, emp00_title_cd, emp00_pos_cd, emp01_order_seq

WITH emp00 AS (SELECT * FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, f_today())) , org00 AS (SELECT * FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, f_today())) SELECT FROM emp00 trans INNER JOIN org00 ON org00_org_id = emp00_org_code_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp00_person_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp01_person_id = #{personId} AND emp00_trans_cd LIKE #{transCode} /* 겸직을 제외하고는 %로 전달 */ AND emp00_trans_cd != CASE WHEN #{transCode} = '%' THEN '800' ELSE '%' END AND emp00_trans_date = ( SELECT max(x.emp00_trans_date) FROM emp00 x WHERE x.emp00_person_id = trans.emp00_person_id AND x.emp00_trans_cd LIKE #{transCode} AND x.emp00_trans_cd != CASE WHEN #{transCode} = '%' THEN '800' ELSE '%' END ) LIMIT 1

WITH emp00 AS (SELECT * FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, #{baseDate}::date)) , org00 AS (SELECT * FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, #{baseDate}::date)) SELECT emp01_person_id AS person_id, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS pos_nm, org00_kor_nm AS org_kor_nm, COALESCE(f_cdnm('EmpGradeCode', emp00_grade_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date), f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date)) AS title_nm2, f_cdnm('EmpKindCode', emp00_kind_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS kind_nm, emp01_hire_date AS hire_date, emp01_email_addr AS email_addr, emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno, emp01_office_telno AS office_telno FROM emp00 INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON org00_org_id = emp00_org_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > #{baseDate}::date OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < #{baseDate}::date ) ) AND emp00_org_code_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE org_tree_down(org00_org_code_id, org00_parent_code_id, org00_kor_nm, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.org00_org_id, a.org00_parent_code_id, a.org00_kor_nm, 0, ARRAY[a.org00_kor_nm::text], false FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, #{baseDate}::date) a WHERE 1=1 AND org00_org_id = #{orgCodeId} UNION ALL SELECT a.org00_org_id, a.org00_parent_code_id, a.org00_kor_nm, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, a.org00_kor_nm::text), a.org00_kor_nm = any(b.path) FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, #{baseDate}::date) a , org_tree_down b WHERE 1=1 AND a.org00_parent_code_id = b.org00_org_code_id AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.org00_org_code_id FROM org_tree_down a ) ORDER BY LPAD(COALESCE(CASE WHEN emp01_order_seq = '' THEN null ELSE emp01_order_seq END,'9999999999'), 10, '0') , org00_org_cd , org00_sort_order , emp00_pos_cd , emp01_hire_date
